_comment: Pins everything scripts/sync-rustdesk.ps1 pulls from outside this repo.
rustdesk.tag is the SOURCE version (Dart/Android); engine.tag is the
PREBUILT ENGINE version. They are allowed to differ - and currently do -
because the engine ships as a binary we do not build. Read CLAUDE.md
before changing either: the bridge in overlay/lib/ is generated from the
engine's Rust source and must agree with engine.tag, not rustdesk.tag.

engine._note: sha256 of lib/arm64-v8a/librustdesk.so inside that APK

_note: Committed at overlay/lib/generated_bridge*.dart. It declares one symbol
removes its only call site. sync-rustdesk.ps1 re-checks this every run.

neodesk._note: versionName comes from neodesk_core/lib/core/version.dart; keep this monotonic
